Carrying a solar spectral sensor, Earth radiation sensor and dosimeter payload.

Description

COSPAR-1 spacecraft is a 3U spacecraft carrying a solar spectral sensor from LASP at CU Boulder that will observe the sun in 18 channels from IR to UV, An Earth radiation sensor from LATMOS in France to observe outgoing long wave radiation and a dosimeter payload from National Central University in Taiwan to observe charged particles in Low Earth Orbit.

The spacecraft bus is being provide by Hex20 Australia and launch is being Contributed by Skyroot India. COSPAR-1 is truly an international effort managed by COSPAR TGCSS with the Laboratory for Atmospheric and Space Physics at University of Colorado providing overall program management.
